title: Sprint 12 Mid-Sprint Check
raw_text:
Sarah: Quick check on the migration. Karim, where are we?

Karim: Schema conversion is done. I finished it last Thursday. The rollback plan is on Confluence as promised. I am now running data migration scripts on the staging environment.

Sarah: Any issues so far?

Karim: One problem. The legacy reports module uses raw SQL queries that are MySQL-specific. I need to rewrite about 15 queries. That will take two extra days.

Sarah: So the March 14 deadline is at risk?

Karim: Yes. I think we need to push it to March 17. The rewrite is unavoidable.

Sarah: Understood. New deadline is March 17. Karim, send me a list of the 15 queries by tomorrow so I can review the scope.

Karim: I will send the list by end of day tomorrow, March 11.

Youssef: On my side, the API call inventory was delivered on March 5 as planned. No blockers from frontend.

Sarah: Good. Let us keep moving. Next check at the sprint review on March 17.
